stem: 3. If U={a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h}, A={b, d, f, h} and B={a, d, e, h}, find the following sets.

entries.question: (i) A′
steps: Use U = {a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h}, A = {b, d, f, h} and B = {a, d, e, h} as printed in Question 3.
A′ = U−A = {a, c, e, g} and B′ = U−B = {b, c, f, g}.
Apply the set operation A′ to obtain {a, c, e, g}.
Check every result against membership in U and the definition of A′.
entries.mathCheck: independent finite-set operations; De Morgan and involution identities

entries.question: (ii) B′
steps: Use U = {a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h}, A = {b, d, f, h} and B = {a, d, e, h} as printed in Question 3.
A′ = U−A = {a, c, e, g} and B′ = U−B = {b, c, f, g}.
Apply the set operation B′ to obtain {b, c, f, g}.
Check every result against membership in U and the definition of B′.
entries.mathCheck: independent finite-set operations; De Morgan and involution identities

entries.question: (iii) A′∪B′
steps: Use U = {a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h}, A = {b, d, f, h} and B = {a, d, e, h} as printed in Question 3.
A′ = U−A = {a, c, e, g} and B′ = U−B = {b, c, f, g}.
Apply the set operation A′∪B′ to obtain {a, c, e, g, b, f}.
Check every result against membership in U and the definition of A′∪B′.
entries.mathCheck: independent finite-set operations; De Morgan and involution identities

entries.question: (iv) A′∩B′
steps: Use U = {a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h}, A = {b, d, f, h} and B = {a, d, e, h} as printed in Question 3.
A′ = U−A = {a, c, e, g} and B′ = U−B = {b, c, f, g}.
Apply the set operation A′∩B′ to obtain {c, g}.
Check every result against membership in U and the definition of A′∩B′.

steps: Use U = {a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h}, A = {b, d, f, h} and B = {a, d, e, h} as printed in Question 3.
A′ = U−A = {a, c, e, g} and B′ = U−B = {b, c, f, g}.

steps: Use U = {a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h}, A = {b, d, f, h} and B = {a, d, e, h} as printed in Question 3.
